# Jun-Hsiang Enterprise Co., Ltd. (鈞翔實業有限公司)

> 100% Made in Taiwan custom silicone and rubber OEM manufacturer with over 30 years of mold development and production experience, ISO 9001:2015 certified, located in Xinzhuang District, New Taipei City, Taiwan.

## Core Capabilities
- **LSR Liquid Silicone Rubber Injection Molding**: Precision medical, food-grade (US FDA / EU LFGB), optical, and high-consistency parts.
- **Solid Silicone (HCR) Compression Molding**: Vacuum compression molding for custom seals, gaskets, industrial vibration dampers, and keypads.
- **Silicone Overmolding (Insert Molding)**: Silicone-to-metal (iron, aluminum, stainless steel, brass) and silicone-to-engineering-plastic (PC, PA) bonding.
- **Self-Lubricating (Oil-Bleeding) Silicone**: Low-friction wire harness seals and waterproof connector plugs for automotive and UAV applications.
- **Specialty Elastomers**: Fluorosilicone (FVMQ), Viton (FKM), and conductive silicone keypads.
